English: Report a problem in your area and track whether it gets fixed.
ha draft: Ka kai rahoton matsala a yankinka, ka bi diddigin ko an gyara ta.
Gundumar ko ƙaramar hukuma (ba dole ba)
Ban tabbata ba (yi amfani da dukan yankin)

English: Avoid faces and house numbers. You can hide them after you take the photo.
ha draft: Ka guji ɗaukar fuskokin mutane da lambar gida. Za ka iya ɓoye su bayan ka ɗauki hoton.

English: Tap the map to mark the spot, or use your location.
ha draft: Danna taswira ka nuna wurin, ko ka yi amfani da wurinka.

English: Your device cannot share its location. Tap the map instead.
ha draft: Na’urarka ba za ta iya raba wurinta ba. Danna taswira maimakon haka.

English: Location is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or tap the map.
ha draft: An hana wuri. Ba da izini a browser ɗinka, ko ka danna taswira.

English: Choose the problem and add a photo.
Choose the area and mark the spot on the map.
ha draft: Zaɓi yankin ka nuna wurin a taswira.

English: Choose a problem, an area, a photo, and mark the spot.
ha draft: Zaɓi matsala, yanki, hoto, kuma ka nuna wurin.

English: The report was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
ha draft: Ba a aika rahoton ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
Wataƙila an riga an kai rahoton wannan

English: Confirming an existing report makes it harder to ignore.
ha draft: Tabbatar da rahoton da ya riga ya kasance yana sa a yi wuya a yi watsi da shi.

English: Ask neighbors to confirm it. Three confirmations mark it as verified.
ha draft: Ka roƙi maƙwabta su tabbatar da shi. Tabbatarwa uku na sa a tabbatar da shi.
An aika wa ofishin da ke da alhaki

ha draft: An sake buɗewa: maƙwabta sun ce ba a gyara ba

ha draft: Ofishin ya ce ba alhakinsa ba ne

English: Hide faces, number plates or house numbers
ha draft: Ɓoye fuskoki, lambobin mota ko lambobin gida

English: Drag a box over anything that identifies a person: faces, number plates, house numbers. It is covered with a coarse mosaic on this phone, before anything is sent.
ha draft: Ja akwati a kan duk abin da ke nuna mutum: fuskoki, lambobin mota, lambobin gida. Za a rufe shi da mosaic a wannan wayar kafin a aika komai.

English: That box was too small. Drag a bigger one.
ha draft: Akwatin ya yi ƙanƙanta. Ja babba.

English: Report a problem in under a minute, even without signal. Neighbors confirm it, the responsible office is named, and every day it stays open is on the record.
ha draft: Kai rahoton matsala cikin ƙasa da minti ɗaya, ko ba tare da network ba. Maƙwabta su tabbatar, a bayyana ofishin da ke da alhaki, kuma kowace rana da matsalar ta ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe a rubuce take.
Matakai uku. Kowanne a bainar jama’a.
Yana aiki ba tare da network ba
Ba a bayyana ainihin wuri ba

English: A photo and the exact spot. Saved on your phone first, so weak signal never loses it.
ha draft: Hoto da ainihin wurin. Ana adana shi a wayarka tukuna, don haka rashin ƙarfin network ba zai ɓata shi ba.

English: Three confirmations verify the problem and make it hard to ignore.
ha draft: Tabbatarwa uku na tabbatar da matsalar kuma suna sa a yi wuya a yi watsi da ita.

English: Moderators escalate to whoever is responsible. Every step stays on the record.
ha draft: Masu kula (moderators) na kai ƙara ga wanda ke da alhaki. Kowane mataki a rubuce yake.
